2608.14089.title: Regime-Conditional Verification: Correctness Estimation for Adapting and Monitoring Safety Classifiers
2608.14089.paper_summary: Safety classifiers deployed with large language models often fail for two reasons: their decisions reflect the policy learned during training rather than the deployer's desired policy, and their performance degrades as deployment traffic evolves. We present Regime-Conditional Verification (RCV), a lightweight wrapper that adapts an off-the-shelf safety classifier without retraining it. RCV estimates, from the classifier's internal representations, the probability that each prediction disagrees with the deployer's policy, and selectively corrects predictions likely to be wrong. The same correctness estimates also provide a label-free signal for detecting distribution shift, enabling a maintenance loop that updates the correctness estimation layer and resorts to classifier fine-tuning only when necessary. Across three off-the-shelf safety classifiers and two benchmark datasets, RCV improves adherence to the deployer's policy in every classifier-dataset combination, catching up to 0.81 of previously missed unsafe content without modifying the underlying classifier. In a deployment study with ten attack campaigns, each a harm category held out of RCV's training, RCV detects every campaign in a dedicated injection panel; in the maintenance census most drift episodes are repaired without updating the classifier, and the fine-tune is reserved for the residual episodes that repair does not restore.
2608.14089.paper_summary_zh: 安全分類器在大型語言模型中部署時，通常因為兩個原因而失效：它們的決策反映了訓練期間學習的政策，而不是部署者所期望的政策，並且隨著部署流量的演變，它們的性能會下降。<lb/>我們提出了狀態條件驗證（Regime-Conditional Verification, RCV），這是一個輕量級的包裝器，可以在不重新訓練的情況下適應現成的安全分類器。<lb/>RCV 從分類器的內部表示中估計每個預測與部署者政策不一致的概率，並有選擇性地修正可能錯誤的預測。<lb/>相同的正確性估計還提供了一個無標籤的信號，用於檢測分佈變化，從而啟用一個維護循環，更新正確性估計層，並僅在必要時進行分類器的微調。<lb/>在三個現成的安全分類器和兩個基準數據集上，RCV 在每個分類器-數據集組合中都提高了對部署者政策的遵循，捕捉到高達 0.81 的先前錯過的不安全內容，而不修改底層分類器。<lb/>在一項包含十個攻擊活動的部署研究中，每個活動都是 RCV 訓練中保留的傷害類別，RCV 在專用的注入面板中檢測到每個活動；在維護普查中，大多數漂移事件在不更新分類器的情況下得以修復，而微調則保留給修復無法恢復的剩餘事件。
2608.14089.author: Thiago Sandoval et.al.
